sections.title: 一、单项选择
sections.instruction: 从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.prompt: 选出画线部分发音与其他三项不同的选项。
questions.translation: 选出画线部分发音与其他三项不同的选项。
questions.explanation: near、hear、dear 中的 ear 发音为 /ɪə/，而 wear 中的 ear 发音为 /eə/，与其他三项不同。故选 w<u>ear</u>。

questions.prompt: I don't like this TV show. I think it's too ______.
questions.translation: 我不喜欢这个电视节目。我觉得它太无聊了。
questions.explanation: 由前句“我不喜欢这个电视节目”可知，说话人认为它很无聊（boring）。exciting 令人兴奋的；useful 有用的；relaxing 令人放松的。故选 boring。

questions.prompt:
—Remember ______ Nancy this evening.
—OK. I won't forget it.
questions.translation:
——记得今晚给南希打电话。
——好的。我不会忘记的。
questions.explanation: remember to do sth. 意为“记得去做某事（事情还未做）”；remember doing sth. 意为“记得做过某事”。此处表示提醒对方今晚去打电话，应用不定式 to call。故选 to call。

questions.prompt: "I love you"—three warm words. They're hard to say ______ mean so much.
questions.translation: “我爱你”——三个温暖的词。它们很难说出口，但意义重大。
questions.explanation: 前半句“很难说出口”与后半句“意义重大”之间存在转折关系，应用并列连词 but 连接。故选 but。

questions.prompt:
—Grandma Lee is quite ______ these kids.
—Yeah! She is ______ telling stories and all the children like her a lot.
questions.translation:
——李奶奶和这些孩子相处得很好。
——是啊！她擅长讲故事，所有的孩子都很喜欢她。
questions.explanation: be good with 意为“善于应付……的；和……相处得好”；be good at 意为“擅长……”。第一空表示和孩子相处得好，用 good with；第二空表示擅长讲故事，用 good at。故选 good with; good at。

sections.title: 二、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Everyone needs friends in daily life. Do you have any good friends? Do you know what subjects they like?

As for me, I have [1] friends. We are in the same school, but we are quite different. Let me tell you what [2] they like. John's favorite subject is computer. He thinks the [3] can help him a lot in his study. But he sometimes plays computer games for a long time. It is [4] his eyes. Jack likes art best because he likes drawing pictures very much. Drawing also [5] him happy. Mary likes English [6] her father is an English teacher. They often talk in English at home. She [7] English well, and she wants to help her friends with English. Bob thinks maths is very [8], but he likes maths best. He does maths homework [9]. He spends much time studying this subject. David likes PE because he likes doing sports. He is good at [10] basketball and football. I play ball games with him every Saturday, so I am healthy and strong.

These are my good friends. Can you tell me something about your good friends?

questions.translation: 至于我，我有五个朋友。
questions.explanation: 下文依次提到了 John、Jack、Mary、Bob、David 共五位好朋友。故选 five。

questions.translation: 让我告诉你他们喜欢什么科目。
questions.explanation: 由第一段“Do you know what subjects they like?”以及下文介绍每位朋友最喜欢的科目可知，此处指 subjects（科目）。故选 subjects。

questions.translation: 他认为电脑在学习上能给他很大帮助。
questions.explanation: 前句提到 John 最喜欢的科目是计算机（computer），此处指电脑能帮助他学习。故选 computer。

questions.translation: 这对他的眼睛不好。
questions.explanation: 长时间玩电脑游戏对眼睛有害，be bad for 意为“对……有害”。故选 bad for。

questions.translation: 画画也让他感到快乐。
questions.explanation: make sb. + 形容词，意为“使某人……”，此处表示画画使他开心。故选 makes。

questions.translation: 玛丽喜欢英语，因为她的爸爸是一名英语老师。
questions.explanation: 后句“她爸爸是英语老师”是前句“玛丽喜欢英语”的原因，应用连词 because 引导原因状语从句。故选 because。

questions.translation: 她英语说得很好，她想在英语方面帮助她的朋友。
questions.explanation: 表示“说某种语言”应用动词 speak，主语 She 为第三人称单数，故用 speaks。故选 speaks。

questions.translation: 鲍勃认为数学很难，但他最喜欢数学。
questions.explanation: 由连词 but（但是）表示转折可知，虽然他最喜欢数学，但他认为数学很难（difficult）。故选 difficult。

questions.translation: 他做数学作业很慢。
questions.explanation: 由前句认为数学难以及后句“他花很多时间学习这门学科”可知，他做数学作业比较慢（slowly）。故选 slowly。

questions.translation: 他擅长打篮球和踢足球。
questions.explanation: 表示“打篮球、踢足球”等球类运动用动词 play，be good at 后接动名词 playing。故选 playing。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
**Sharing my school**

**Jane Wood** *2 hours ago*

Hi! I'm Jane Wood, a student in Grade Seven in Appleton Junior School. 2,500 students and 200 teachers are in our school. I have eight subjects. English is the subject I like best. Our school has lots of clubs, and I want to join the English club.

I love my school. Everything is new and modern. The classrooms are big and the gym has good showers. There are computer rooms, a library and an indoor swimming pool here. Do you want to know more about my school?

**Fred** *3 hours ago*

I'm from Queen Victoria Comprehensive School. It is a big school in Scotland with 2,200 students and 190 teachers. My school day begins at 9:00 and finishes at 3:30. I have eight subjects. I like Chinese best. Everything in the school is old. Chairs are uncomfortable. I like the sports field best. I am in the football club. Would you like to come to my school?

questions.prompt: What kind of text are they?
questions.translation: 它们是什么类型的文本？
questions.explanation: 由页面标题“Sharing my school”以及发帖时间“2 hours ago”、“3 hours ago”可知，这是两篇网络帖子（Online posts）。故选 Online posts.。

questions.prompt: What subject does Jane like best?
questions.translation: 简最喜欢什么科目？
questions.explanation: 由 Jane Wood 帖子中的“English is the subject I like best.”可知，简最喜欢英语。故选 English.。

questions.prompt: How is Jane's school different from Fred's school?
options: Jane's school is modern, while Fred's school is old.
Jane's school has a football club, while Fred's school does not.
Jane's school day is longer than Fred's school day.
Jane likes English best, while Fred likes Chinese best.
questions.translation: 简的学校和弗雷德的学校有什么不同？
questions.explanation: 题干询问两所学校的不同之处。Jane 提到“Everything is new and modern.”，而 Fred 提到“Everything in the school is old.”。故选 Jane's school is modern, while Fred's school is old.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Li Miao is Alice's teacher. She is an art teacher, but she's different from many other teachers. Students only have her classes on the Internet. Ms Li has an organization(组织)—P. Art. It gives art lessons with many art galleries (展览馆) and artists(艺术家) on the Internet. Ms Li wants to give children art lessons in a new way. In her classes, artists tell students the history of art galleries. They also tell stories behind some pictures. And students can ask questions in class too. Then she answers their questions.

Many students like Ms Li's classes very much because they can learn art in a new and interesting way. They don't need to go out but they can visit many different kinds of art galleries and enjoy pictures all over the world. Why does Ms Li give this kind of class? Because she thinks art is <u>vital</u>. It can help students with their study and help them live a good life. She wants children to love art and enjoy the beauty (美) of art by having her lessons.

questions.prompt: Why is Li Miao different from other teachers?
options: Because her classes are on the Internet.
questions.translation: 为什么李苗和其他老师不同？
questions.explanation: 由第一段“she's different from many other teachers. Students only have her classes on the Internet.”可知，她的课只在网上进行。故选 Because her classes are on the Internet.。

questions.prompt:
What can students do in Ms Li's classes?
① They can ask questions. ② They can work in a gallery.
③ They can listen to stories. ④ They can know about art galleries.
questions.translation: 学生在李老师的课上能做什么？
questions.explanation: 由第一段可知，艺术家会讲美术馆的历史（④），讲画作背后的故事（③），学生也可以在课上提问（①）；文中未提及在美术馆工作（②）。故选 ①③④。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "vital" in the last paragraph mean?
questions.translation: 最后一段中画线词“vital”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 由后句“It can help students with their study and help them live a good life.”可知，艺术对学生的学习和生活很有帮助，因此“vital”意为“重要的（Important）”。故选 Important.。

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for this passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了通过互联网以全新方式教授艺术课的特殊美术老师李苗。故选 A Special Art Teacher。

sections.title: 五、短文填空
sections.instruction:
用方框中所给单词的适当形式填空，使短文完整正确。（每个单词限用一次，每空限填一个单词。）

备选词：class | learn | interest | but | in | be | help | really | what | they
sections.passage:
Do you know school gardening? It is an [1] (interest) subject.

For many students, they would like to [2] (learn) outside the classroom. They learn to plant vegetables with [3] (they) hands. When some young students eat, they may ask themselves, "Where [4] (be) the food from?" This class [5] (help) them get the answer.

For some teachers, they [6] (really) like having classes in school gardens. In class, teachers decide (决定) [7] (what) vegetables to plant. Then they plant them with students. Their favourite vegetables are carrots and tomatoes. Teachers and students like to wash them and eat them [8] (in) the garden. Besides, by taking these [9] (class), students get to know vegetables better. For example, some vegetables are easy to grow well, [10] (but) others need a long time.

questions.translation: 它是一门有趣的学科。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 subject（事物）应用 -ing 结尾的形容词 interesting，意为“有趣的”。故选 interesting。

questions.translation: 对于许多学生来说，他们想要在教室外学习。
questions.explanation: would like to do sth. 意为“想要做某事”，to 后接动词原形 learn。故选 learn。

questions.translation: 他们学习用自己的双手种植蔬菜。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 hands 应用形容词性物主代词 their（他们的）。故选 their。

questions.translation: “食物来自哪里？”
questions.explanation: 主语 the food 为不可数名词，谓语动词 be 应用第三人称单数形式 is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 这门课帮助他们得到答案。
questions.explanation: 主语 This class 为第三人称单数，且全文为一般现在时，谓语动词应用三单形式 helps。故选 helps。

questions.translation: 对于一些老师来说，他们真的很喜欢在学校菜园里上课。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 like 应用副词 really（真正地）。故选 really。

questions.translation: 在课堂上，老师们决定种什么蔬菜。
questions.explanation: 此处表示“什么蔬菜”，应用疑问词 what 修饰 vegetables，构成“what + 名词 + to do”结构。故选 what。

questions.translation: 老师和学生们喜欢把它们洗干净，在菜园里吃。
questions.explanation: 表示“在菜园里”应用介词 in（in the garden）。故选 in。

questions.translation: 此外，通过上这些课，学生们能更好地了解蔬菜。
questions.explanation: 空前有指示代词 these（这些），故可数名词 class 应用复数形式 classes。故选 classes。

questions.translation: 例如，有些蔬菜很容易长得好，但另一些需要很长时间。
questions.explanation: 前后分句之间存在对比转折关系，应用连词 but（但是）。故选 but。
